title: Geometric Pop
description: Illustration vectorielle nette aux contours rigides, caractérisée par des aplats de couleurs et un ombrage en cel-shading géométrique. Elle présente des silhouettes acérées, l'absence totale de dégradés et une palette audacieuse et contrastée rappelant le design graphique éditorial moderne.
prompt: Crisp 2D vector illustration, flat graphic design, hard-edged cel-shading, UPA animation influence. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, no canvas edges, full bleed to all four corners. Execute the composition utilizing perfectly smooth, digital color blocks with zero gradients, zero noise, and zero organic canvas textures. Dominate the palette with intense {{primary_color}}, integrate bold structural forms using {{secondary_color}}, and inject high-contrast focal points with vivid {{accent_color}}. Lighting anatomy relies exclusively on binary, angular drop shadows and stark geometric highlights, completely devoid of soft falloff, subsurface scattering, or ambient occlusion. Subject edges must be razor-sharp, operating as precise vector-cut silhouettes with pristine anti-aliasing. Line work is purposefully minimal, employing solid, unvarying graphic strokes solely for critical structural separation. Spatial dynamics are constructed through deliberate 2D graphic stacking, overlapping flat color planes, and rigid structural alignment, aggressively rejecting realistic atmospheric depth. The visual rhythm is dictated by clean geometric angles, precise sweeping curves, and stark color contrasts, achieving a highly polished, stylized contemporary editorial aesthetic. flat vector, cel-shading, hard edge, geometric forms, solid color blocking, minimalist layout, vector art, graphic design, modern editorial, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.temporal_texture: Vector edges remain flawlessly sharp, and flat color fills stay perfectly solid without any flickering, noise, or lighting shifts.
video.avoid: Avoid motion blur, 3D camera rotation, organic flowing movements, lighting changes, or any introduction of gradients and textures.
